input.summary: Narrow non-solicit to mutual, 12 months, personnel directly involved in the Agreement
input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept a non-solicit only if it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performing this Agreement, and runs 12 months from the end of that involvement; a three-year restriction on every Licensor and Affiliate employee is outside our range. We have kept the existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs unchanged.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period following the end of the relevant individual's involvement in the performance of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party.
